title: Countable simplicial intervals detect equivalence lifting
statement:
Use simplicial sets, standard simplices, boundaries and horns [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. A small simplicial category has a set of objects, simplicial mapping sets, identity vertices and associative unital simplicial composition. Let $\mathrm{sCat}$ be their category, with arbitrary object functions on enriched functors. It is complete, cocomplete and locally presentable: for some regular cardinal $\kappa$ it is generated under $\kappa$-filtered colimits by a small set of objects whose ordinary Hom functors preserve these colimits. For a fixed object set $O$, the category $\mathrm{sCat}_O$ of simplicial categories and functors equal to the identity on $O$ has a cofibrantly generated model structure with objectwise weak homotopy equivalences and objectwise Kan fibrations; its cofibrations are retracts of free simplicial extensions (degreewise free enriched-category extensions with degeneracies preserving the chosen free generators).

For a simplicial set $K$, let $U(K)$ have objects $0,1$, mapping set $K$ from $0$ to $1$, identity mapping sets $\Delta^0$, and empty mapping set from $1$ to $0$. Let $I$ consist of $\varnothing\to\{0\}$ and $U(\partial\Delta^n)\to U(\Delta^n)$ for $n\geq0$. Let $J$ consist of $U(\Lambda_i^n)\to U(\Delta^n)$ for $n\geq1$, $0\leq i\leq n$, and $\{0\}\to H$ for a set of representatives of two-object simplicial categories $H$ with all four mapping sets weakly contractible, countably many simplices in each mapping set, and $\{0\}\amalg\{1\}\to H$ a cofibration in $\mathrm{sCat}_{\{0,1\}}$. Write $K\text{-inj}$ for maps with the right lifting property against $K$, $K\text{-cof}$ for maps with the left lifting property against $K\text{-inj}$, and $K\text{-cell}$ for transfinite composites of pushouts of coproducts of maps in $K$. Both $I$ and $J$ admit functorial small-object factorizations as a $K\text{-cell}$ map followed by a $K\text{-inj}$ map; every $K\text{-cof}$ map is a retract of a $K\text{-cell}$ map. Every map of $J$ belongs to $I\text{-cof}$.

For a simplicial functor $p:A\to B$, membership in $J\text{-inj}$ is equivalent to the conjunction of: each $A(a,a')\to B(pa,pa')$ is a Kan fibration; and for every object $a$ of $A$ and every vertex $e:pa\to b$ invertible in $\pi_0 B$, there are an object $a'$ with $pa'=b$ and a vertex $d:a\to a'$ invertible in $\pi_0 A$ with $p(d)=e$ as vertices. Here $\pi_0$ takes components of each mapping set, and invertible means having a two-sided inverse in this ordinary category.
